import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0ChartVMonotone
import Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Sites.LocallyBijective

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3

universe u
open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite

namespace AlgebraicGeometry

namespace ProbeP4R6

theorem controlSorry : True := by sorry

variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
variable [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] [GeometricallyReduced C.hom]

theorem probeSheaf (X : Scheme.{u}) :
    Presheaf.IsSheaf Scheme.zariskiTopology (yoneda.obj X) :=
  (isSheaf_iff_isSheaf_of_type _ _).mpr
    (GrothendieckTopology.Subcanonical.isSheaf_of_isRepresentable (yoneda.obj X))

noncomputable def chartSheaf (X : Scheme.{u}) : Sheaf Scheme.zariskiTopology.{u} (Type u) :=
  ⟨yoneda.obj X, probeSheaf X⟩

noncomputable def chartSheafHom {X : Scheme.{u}} (f : yoneda.obj X ⟶ (pic0SigmaSheaf C).1) :
    chartSheaf X ⟶ pic0SigmaSheaf C :=
  ⟨f⟩

/-- A: from IsIso of the sheaf hom, the presheaf map is app-wise bijective. -/
theorem probeBij {X : Scheme.{u}} (f : yoneda.obj X ⟶ (pic0SigmaSheaf C).1)
    (h : IsIso (chartSheafHom (C := C) f)) (T : Scheme.{u}ᵒᵖ) :
    Function.Bijective (f.app T) := by
  haveI := h
  have hI : IsIso f := by
    have : IsIso ((sheafToPresheaf Scheme.zariskiTopology (Type u)).map
        (chartSheafHom (C := C) f)) := inferInstance
    exact this
  rw [← isIso_iff_bijective]
  exact inferInstance

/-- B: THE CONVERSE -- an iso of presheaves is an open immersion of presheaves. -/
theorem probeConv {X : Scheme.{u}} (f : yoneda.obj X ⟶ (pic0SigmaSheaf C).1) [IsIso f] :
    IsOpenImmersion.presheaf f :=
  MorphismProperty.of_isIso (P := IsOpenImmersion.presheaf) f

end ProbeP4R6

end AlgebraicGeometry
